_provenance: analysis/claim_ledger.py — hand-maintained register of every claim, its script, and whether it was pre-declared or post-hoc.

claims.claim: All 50 transcribed post-training rows reproduce from the committed raw batteries
claims.value: 50/50 within half the last published digit
claims.note: The retirement condition was written in the file's own _provenance before the run.

claims.claim: Legibility gap exceeds the present-set baseline on declarative state
claims.note: The paper's existing claim; this is a replication at a new condition.

claims.claim: The gap replicates across models and families
claims.note: Replication was the declared purpose of the model sweep.

claims.claim: The probe reads the QUERIED BINDING, not an entity code
claims.value: follows new query 0.866, stays on old 0.095, floor 0.250
claims.note: Named in the script specification before implementation.

claims.claim: Repair with the decoded target beats its controls on Pythia
claims.value: decoded 0.466-0.593 vs random 0.073-0.128, wrong_target 0.058; noop exactly 0.000
claims.note: Arms and the noop identity requirement were declared before the run.

claims.claim: Repair does NOT transfer to Qwen2.5 / OLMo-2, and the ORACLE fails there too
claims.note: Observed, not predicted. Diagnoses the intervention SITE, not the probe. Claim Pythia only.

claims.claim: The mutable failure is not a convention-inference failure
claims.value: explicit prompt 0.221 vs implicit 0.249 accuracy (no rescue)
claims.note: Run specifically to falsify the alternative explanation raised against our own result.

claims.claim: Accessibility exceeds behaviour and the gap WIDENS through pretraining
claims.note: CONDITIONAL on two things. (1) The read layer is fixed at the FINAL checkpoint, which could manufacture the widening if the binding moves layers early; the per-checkpoint-best-layer control is in the code and the claim is NOT settled until it holds under both readings. (2) The widening is SCALE-DEPENDENT: significant at 1.4B, not at 410M. State it as such.

claims.claim: At the final checkpoint the probe recovers the binding on trials the model fails
Representation and use have DIFFERENT ONSET TIMES
claims.note: Falsification condition was declared before running: 'lag <= 0, or a CI spanning 0'. Result: lag +0.061, CI [-0.100, +0.212] SPANS ZERO. The developmental result is about ASYMPTOTE, not onset. Onset is additionally LEFT-CENSORED (R already above baseline at the first checkpoint). Do not write 'representation develops before use'.

claims.claim: The recipe effect does not survive controlling for scale
claims.note: This is the paper's own claim, tested directly. DISAGREES with the paper. Scope limit: all models <=3B, while the paper's claim spans 70M-12B.

claims.claim: Binding capacity follows a power law in parameter count
claims.note: NOTICED because the scale coefficient's interval contained 1.0. The campaign's most striking result and the one most in need of independent replication. Leave-one-family-out spans 0.759-1.086; Pythia contributes 6 of 11 models.

claims.claim: Capacity does not predict interference robustness (separate axes)
claims.note: AGREES with the paper. Analysis chosen after the D=0 result; the D=256 cells already existed.

claims.value: median retained fraction 0.535; reduces capacity in 10/11
claims.note: Requires normalising by the D=0 ceiling; own-ceiling normalisation INVERTS the sign.

claims.claim: The entire GPT-2 family cannot hold one binding above the exclusion floor
claims.value: gpt2, gpt2-medium, gpt2-large all excluded at chance
claims.note: Observed. The exclusion rule itself is inherited from capacity_stats.py, not invented here.

claims.claim: Chess d250/w1 accelerates target learning (pre-registered replication)
claims.value: NOT CONFIRMED: chess 20/20 crossing, median 6375 vs baseline 6750 (n=39), Mann-Whitney censored-ranked-worst p=0.73; phase-B clock p=0.41
claims.note: PREREG_d250_replication.md uploaded to S3 before launch; verdict script committed before any run finished. Gates: median-lower PASS, p<0.05 FAIL, specificity PASS -> NOT CONFIRMED. The earlier p=0.025 (declared rule, Holm 0.125) did not survive n=20. The prereg carried its own single-test alpha, so this p does not enter this ledger's Holm set.

claims.claim: Shuffled-chess d250 SLOWS learning relative to baseline
claims.value: median 9000 vs 6750, 3/20 never crossed, two-sided p=0.002
claims.note: The TEST was pre-specified (the prereg's gate-3 specificity test) but the significant direction (slower) was not the gated hypothesis. Label the direction post-hoc. Extends the unstructured-data harm result down to dose 250 on the time-to-threshold clock.

claims.claim: Re-formation falls with the MAX UNSUPERVISED GAP at identical mean dose
claims.note: Three readings declared in maint/x14_runner.py before any X14 run existed; the one that fired is P3 NEAR-EVERY-STEP (both intermediate arms below 50%). 8 incomplete rescues EXCLUDED and counted, never scored as failures; the platform terminated, so counts are final. The gap50=64 fit is descriptive, not a declared boundary.
